findings.issue: Proxy kernel execution rather than actual trained model execution
findings.description: physical_model_bench.cpp executed hand-written NEON GEMM/conv loops with synthetic static floats (0.005f) instead of loading the trained ONNX candidate models. Measurements represent proxy architecture kernels, not actual model inference.
findings.remediation: Deploy real_onnx_device_runner linked to /system/lib64/libonnxruntime.so to load actual ONNX weights and execute the true graph on-device.

findings.description: real_train_eval_suite.py trained with epochs=2 when retraining, but recorded epochs=4 in output JSON. Also recorded hard-coded val_loss=0.0020 on checkpoint load.
findings.remediation: Recompute validation loss on validation_set.json upon loading checkpoint, and record exact executed epochs.

findings.description: Only pt_out[0] (intent_logits) was compared against ort_out[0]; action_logits, risk, and confidence were unchecked.
findings.remediation: Verify numerical parity across all 4 output heads: intent_logits, action_logits, risk, and confidence.

findings.issue: Overly conclusive causal claims regarding distillation necessity
findings.description: Report claimed distillation was mathematically 'required', rather than stating that small-dataset scratch training showed poor generalization, motivating distillation as the next research hypothesis.
findings.remediation: Weaken conclusive language into hypothesis-driven scientific phrasing.
